name: p6_cor32_mono
statement: (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : StrictMono (fun n : ℤ => ((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ))
closed: ∀ (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k), StrictMono (fun n : ℤ => ((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ))
informal: Corollary 3.2, monotonicity: the abscissa x_n=f_{2n}/f_{2n+1} of P_n is strictly increasing in n in Z
original: the abscissa x_n=f_{2n}/f_{2n+1} of P_n is strictly increasing in n in Z
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), 1 ≤ k → StrictMono fun n => ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))
